topItems.title: Show HN: I trained a 125M model to autocomplete piano on-device
topItems.excerpt: I trained a 125M-parameter transformer to autocomplete piano performances in real time (~108 notes/sec on an iPhone 15). The idea is basically GitHub Copilot or Tabnine, except instead of prompting it with code, you prompt it by playing a few notes on a MIDI piano. The model...
